name: process_workcenter
label: Work Order Center Classification Table
description: Work order center classification table is used for filtering enabled states in workflows, time dimension statistics, and association queries.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Unique identifier for category, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Factory: default system: system category custom: custom category. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sort by size, smaller ID first. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: support
fields.description: Use display range. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: is_show_total
fields.description: Should the total count be displayed, by default, the pending count should be shown.

fields.name: thead_config_hash
fields.description: Default table header configuration hash. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the UUID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_sort
indexes.description: Standard index covering the sort field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_support
indexes.description: Standard index covering the support field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_thead_config_hash
indexes.description: Standard index covering the thead_config_hash field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_type
indexes.description: Standard index covering the type field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
